chapterTitle: Chapter 13 Structure Determination: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
title: Problem 13-23

pages.text: PROBLEM 13-23 We saw in Section 9.3 that addition of HBr to a terminal alkyne leads to the Markovnikov addition product, with the Br bonding to the more highly substituted carbon. How could you use 13C NMR to identify the product of the addition of 1 equivalent of HBr to 1-hexyne?
